raw_segments.text: In countries where modern civilization has become fully developed,
a new class of petty bourgeois has been formed,
and ever renewing itself as a supplementary part of bourgeois society.
The individual members of this class, however,
are being constantly hurled down into the proletariat by the action of competition,
they even see the moment approaching when they will completely disappear
as an independent section of modern society,
to be replaced in manufacturers, agriculture, and commerce
